_meta.probe: value-token discriminator for update-vs-duplicate at store time
_meta.note: Aggregates only. The per-pair examples are withheld: they quote verbatim production memory content.

the_bug.symptom: store() has two outcomes, duplicate and stored. A fact that supersedes another is near-identical to it by construction, clears the 0.90 cosine bar, and is returned as 'duplicate' — the new value is lost.
the_bug.exposed_path: extract.py passes dedup_threshold=0.90 on every batch and MEMORY_EXTRACT=1 is on; extraction is the only unattended write path.

discriminator_on_real_pairs.rule: value tokens differ, where a value token is a dotted version, a kebab/snake symbol, a backticked literal, or a bare count
discriminator_on_real_pairs.reading: The rate falls as similarity rises, which is the right direction: the more alike two memories are, the more likely the second really is a restatement. It does not fall far enough to call this a precision measurement.

estimated_impact.note: 519 of 624 semantic rejections (83%) sat in the 0.90-0.95 band, where 92.9% of pairs carry diverging values. Point estimate: roughly 480-500 of the 624 were facts with a distinct value, discarded.
estimated_impact.exact_hash_path_unchanged: The 171 byte-identical rejections are untouched. Those are true duplicates.

honest_limits.no_labelled_set: The production corpus has no labelled update/duplicate pairs, so this measures how often the rule FIRES, not whether each firing is correct — the same limit P1 recorded for the conflict detector.
honest_limits.population_mismatch: The 107 pairs come from random co-occurring memories in the store, not from the actual dedup population (a new memory compared against existing ones). It is a proxy.
honest_limits.inspected_examples_were_distinct_facts: Every one of the eight inspected reclassifications was a genuinely different memory that dedup at 0.90 would have wrongly rejected — different infrastructure layers, different agent reports sharing a boilerplate prefix. That suggests dedup at 0.90 is over-aggressive on this corpus independently of the update question, but eight is not a sample.
honest_limits.failure_direction_is_deliberate: When the rule fires the memory is STORED and flagged. A false positive costs one near-duplicate row that consolidation can merge; a false negative costs the fact. The asymmetry is why this ships one-directional and never auto-merges.
